content_sections.heading: Tripura University Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Tripura University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tripura University Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 18 September 2026. There is no separate application submission deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: For the Guest Instructor (Violin) post, an M.A. in Instrumental Music (Violin) is required. For the Guest Instructor (Harmonium) post, an M.A. in Hindustani Classical Vocal Music with proficiency in Harmonium playing is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Instructor posts is 40 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Instructor posts, with one vacancy for Guest Instructor (Violin) and one for Guest Instructor (Harmonium).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The salary is offered at Rs. 500 per Class for 2 classes daily, with a maximum monthly earning not exceeding Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Tripura University Guest Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Instructor posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Tripura University, Agartala, Tripura, PIN 799022. The exact venue details should be confirmed from the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Instructor positions are contractual in nature.
